integrity: Analytical proof of signed spectral limits and the explicit pairwise-versus-collective example; finite numerical and algebraic tests are corroborative, not proof of asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite-degree complex polynomials on the unweighted classical Hardy space; no uniformity in degree.
When the maximum of the angular symbol is exactly zero, the leading counting limit does not decide finiteness of positive spectral inertia.
No sharp error estimate or individual-eigenvalue formula is asserted; independent mathematical review has not been performed.
Bibliographic priority is assessed against inspected sources and searches, not certified against unindexed work.
title: Signed Weyl laws and a collective three-frequency instability for Hardy–Volterra self-commutators
